address: 4, Alley 20, Lane 595, Bei'an Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 104, Taiwan
bio: This laid-back bistro has rich blue walls and white tiled dados; cheeky artwork adds to the fun and vibrant ambience. The chef leverages his formal training in Western cuisine to re-create familiar Taiwanese recipes using local produce. His signature roast half chicken with mushroom risotto is a hybrid of Taiwanese barrel charbroiled chicken and the Italian rice dish. Most items are designed for sharing. It is always worth checking the daily specials.
